summary: The proof is correct and complete. The mean and tail formulas, monotonicity identities, and both orientations of the truncated-exponential calculation are valid and cover h = 0, all support cutoffs, and every positive scale; the uniform case completes the log-affine class. The stated specialization of Fradelizi–Guédon Theorem 2 agrees with the publisher source on page 330 (https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s00454-003-2868-y.pdf). The functional is affine and upper semicontinuous on all probabilities on the compact interval. A small positive translation preserves any strict violation, the resulting mean constraint excludes all admissible Dirac masses, and monotonicity of w_h preserves the violation when the nondegenerate log-affine extremizer is recentered. No errors or gaps were found, including in the strict-tail and endpoint conventions.
